entities.name: Domri Rade
entities.description: Human shaman planeswalker and Gruul guildmaster who could summon and command beasts; died in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: Guild driven out of the Rubblebelt by Domri's ragebeasts.

entities.name: Rubblebelt
entities.description: Ruined district of Ravnica where Domri grew up.

entities.name: Borborygmos
entities.description: Cyclops Gruul guildmaster defeated by Domri.

entities.name: Burning Tree clan
entities.description: Gruul clan that made Domri an honorary member.

entities.name: Utvara
entities.description: Place where Domri's rite of passage took place.

entities.name: Nayan skies
entities.description: The world Domri awoke in during his burial.

entities.name: Cylian godtrackers
entities.description: Group who saved Domri from a Gargantuan.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: Space between planes through which Domri was pulled home.

entities.name: Nikya
entities.description: Shaman who saw Domri's ascension as the first sign of the End-Raze.

entities.name: Elderspell
entities.description: Bolas's spell that harvested planeswalker sparks.

events.summary: Orphaned on Ravnica, Domri is too small for any Gruul clan to claim him and befriends feral beasts.
events.quote: he was too small and wiry for any clan of the Gruul to claim him

events.summary: Domri commands ragebeasts to drive the Orzhov out of the Rubblebelt; Borborygmos makes him an honorary Burning Tree member.
events.quote: The cyclops declared Domri an honorary member of the Burning Tree clan.

events.summary: Buried alive in the Gruul rite of passage at Utvara, Domri panics and his eyes are opened.
events.quote: It was then, in the darkness, that his eyes were opened.

events.summary: Domri wakes on Naya, nearly gets killed by a Gargantuan, is saved by Cylian godtrackers and returns home through the Blind Eternities.
events.quote: he was pulled once more through the Blind Eternities to his homeworld

events.summary: With Bolas's help Domri defeats Borborygmos and becomes Gruul guildmaster.
events.quote: becoming the guildmaster by defeating the cyclops Borborygmos

events.summary: Domri leads the Gruul in a mob rampage to push the guilds into chaos.
events.quote: Domri led the Gruul in a concerted effort to tip the world into chaos

events.summary: Domri first fights the Eternals and helps save Kaya, then sides with Bolas after seeing him topple the Vitu-Ghazi elemental.
events.quote: even helped save Kaya in a tight spot

events.summary: The Elderspell harvests Domri's spark, draining all the moisture in his body.
events.quote: All the moisture in his body was drained.
